description: Merge-facing evidence overlay for the 382 generic unresolved short .text ranges selected from remaining_classification.json. The source manifest remains text_classification.json so all recovery overlays share one provenance contract. Live Ghidra disassemble_bytes and independent iced-x86 boundary checks promote exact non-padding instruction extents; INT3/NOP extents remain resolved padding and no bytes are left uncovered.

method.decoder: live Ghidra disassemble_bytes + iced-x86 boundary validation
method.padding_policy: INT3 and one-byte NOP are retained as padding candidates; Ghidra multi-byte NOP encodings (LEA) remain instruction rows
method.boundary_policy: Only bytes in the generic unresolved source ranges are emitted; rows crossing an authenticated pre-existing extent are omitted; this batch had no undecoded bytes; the single 9B-prefixed FSTSW row is preserved as an exact Ghidra extent
